name: Washington County, UT
findings: Washington County has 381 nonprofit organizations. 167 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 132 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Washington County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Washington County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 201 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 1 professional organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?
